aiSummary: Prostatectomy: This is a medical procedure performed to address your specific health condition. It involves careful surgical steps, risks are monitored and minimized, and recovery is typically quick. Most patients go home within 2 days and resume normal activities within 1-2 weeks with proper follow-up care.

steps.title: Anesthesia
steps.description: You will receive anesthesia to keep you comfortable and pain-free during the procedure.

steps.title: Small Incisions
steps.description: Small surgical incisions are made to allow access for the instruments needed.

steps.title: Procedure
steps.description: The main surgical steps are performed carefully by your experienced surgical team.

steps.title: Closure
steps.description: Incisions are closed with dissolvable stitches or surgical glue.

steps.title: Recovery Start
steps.description: You begin recovery with monitoring and pain management in the recovery room.

risks.title: Infection
risks.description: Minor infection at the incision sites can occur but is treatable with antibiotics.

risks.title: Bleeding
risks.description: Rare internal bleeding that may require monitoring or additional care.

risks.title: Anesthesia Reaction
risks.description: Very rare allergic or adverse reaction to anesthesia medications.

alternatives.title: Open Surgery
alternatives.description: Traditional surgical approach with one larger incision instead of small ones.
alternatives.whenRecommended: When minimally invasive approach is not suitable for your condition

alternatives.title: Medical Management
alternatives.description: Medication-focused approach to manage the condition without surgery.
alternatives.whenRecommended: Only for select cases where surgery can be deferred or avoided

recovery.summary: Most patients go home within 2 days and resume light activities within a week. Full recovery typically takes about 1-2 weeks depending on the specific procedure and individual healing.

timeline.label: Day 0
timeline.description: Surgery day with monitoring in recovery room. Rest and pain management.

timeline.label: Day 1
timeline.description: Light walking encouraged. Soft diet. Pain control medications as prescribed.

timeline.label: Day 2-3
timeline.description: Often ready for discharge. Follow wound care instructions carefully.

timeline.label: Week 1
timeline.description: Most routine activities can resume. Continue following medical restrictions.

do: Take all prescribed medications as directed
Walk lightly as advised by your medical team
dont: Submerge incisions in water until cleared
Drive until approved by your doctor
Ignore signs of infection or complications

questions.question: Will you be awake during the Prostatectomy?

options.A: No, you will be under anesthesia
options.B: Yes, you will be fully awake
